title: BioDCASE: Active Learning for Bioacoustics
abstract: arXiv:2609.15255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ecological monitoring increasingly relies on machine learning models, whose performance depends on the quality and quantity of labelled data. However, obtaining these labels is costly, particularly in passive acoustic monitoring, where vast amounts of data are collected but only a small proportion can feasibly be annotated. Active learning addresses this bottleneck by prioritizing which samples should be labelled. However, progress is difficult to measure, because published methods are evaluated under different models, budgets, evaluation metrics and datasets. To address this challenge, we present the 2026 Active Learning for Bioacoustics BioDCASE challenge: a systematic evaluation of sampling methods designed to identify effective AL strategies. translated_title: BioDCASE：面向生物声学的主动学习
translated_abstract: 生态监测越来越依赖机器学习模型，而模型的性能取决于标注数据的质量和数量。然而，获取这些标注的成本很高，尤其是在被动声学监测领域，虽然会收集到海量的数据，但实际能够被标注的只有很小一部分。主动学习通过优先选择哪些样本应当被标注来破解这一瓶颈。然而，相关进展难以衡量，因为已发表的方法是在不同的模型、预算、评估指标和数据集下进行评估的。为应对这一挑战，我们发起了2026年生物声学主动学习BioDCASE挑战赛：这是一项针对采样方法的系统性评估，旨在识别有效的主动学习策略。参赛方法在由陆地和海洋数据组成的四个子集上进行了评估。在来自七个团队的十种采样方法中，排名最高的方法取得了面积未……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发起了2026年生物声学主动学习BioDCASE挑战赛，通过在陆地和海洋声学数据集上对多个团队的主动学习采样方法进行统一、系统性的评估，为衡量主动学习策略在生物声学中的有效性建立了可比较的基准。
en_tdlr: The BioDCASE 2026 challenge establishes a standardized benchmark by systematically evaluating active learning sampling methods from seven teams across terrestrial and marine bioacoustic datasets, enabling fair comparison of AL strategies in ecological acoustic monitoring.
